copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正需要设计微服务架构或拆分已有系统。
copy.tagline_en: Design microservices with patterns for boundaries, events, resilience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing microservices or breaking up a monolith.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按微服务模式做架构设计:划分服务边界、在 REST/gRPC 与 Kafka 等通信方式间做选择、用 Saga 处理分布式数据、用熔断和重试做容错;需要更细的模式时会去读 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当你要把单体应用拆分、设计服务边界,或构建分布式、事件驱动系统时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude designs microservices architectures: decomposing services, choosing sync (REST/gRPC) or async (Kafka, queues) communication, Saga for distributed data, and circuit breaker/retry/bulkhead resilience.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are decomposing a monolith, designing service boundaries, or building distributed or event-driven systems.

say_en.text: Split this monolith into microservices by business capability
